title: PrettyBlocks: Warm 1
description: A pack adding 20 new decorative blocks to Creative Mode!
body:
The 4th pack of the **PrettyBlocks** series, adding **20** new decorative blocks to Creative Mode!

The series consists of several unique block packs, sorted into different themes.

Perfect for floors, paths, accents, and more!

_Note: Blocks do NOT have recipes as of now._ 

Want a feature? Join the discord! We may be able to add it, if it is within reason.

Enjoy!
